|translation='''Title:''' You Have Failed Me For The Last Time.

'''Card text:'''
If Vader is on table, play just after the opponent declares a battle. Target an opponent's leader in that battle with destiny less than 6. If the opponent did not win, the target's forfeit becomes 0 and it is immediately lost. If it is Ozzel, it becomes an excluded card.

'''Lore:'''
Lord Vader. The fleet has left lightspeed, and from now... whoa... ugh... gueh.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is a translated movie line, not a literal English title.
